scope: Corollary 2.20 (The ordinary bridge) of the manuscript “Purely cosmetic surgery on knots in the three-sphere” (preprints/Purely-Cosmetic-Surgery-on-Knots-in-the-Three-Sphere-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 306 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ee916c92b825a868), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an orientation-preserving diffeomorphism ϕ : Y−2 −→ Y2, with fixed bundle and collar identifications. The stacked cobordism and its rigid count T = f− ϕ−1 f+ : Y0 −→ Y0 (2.21) define an integral chain map inducing a unit over F2 and an isomorphism over Q. The cobordism has H1(T; Z) = 0, χ(T) = 4, σ(T) = −2. (2.22) Its two increasing-handle halves are simply connected.
